name: Apply Wall Finish (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Cut in to masked trim with a brush, spray the wall field, then immediately backroll the wet film to work the paint into texture and even the laydown. NC production standard. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between if QT4+.
doctrine: Spray and backroll happen as a coordinated two-person flow: the sprayer leads, the backroller follows within 30 seconds while the film is still wet. Backroll rate matches spray rate because they're synchronized. Coat 2 is faster than coat 1 because the sprayer can move quicker over an already-uniform surface and the backroller has less film irregularity to work out. Complexity modifier still applies — tight rooms slow the spray pattern. Texture modifier is OFF because spray rate is texture-insensitive (the gun atomizes uniformly).
